page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2i-c1m2.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated Intel Xeon vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This server type does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps. There are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this instance.

The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance as a compute-focused resource. It offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads that require dedicated CPU execution cycles but have low memory footprints, avoiding the expense of unutilized RAM. Suitable workloads include lightweight web serving, batch processing, microservices, and basic build systems.
